subject.title: fix(plugins): honor subagent model-override opt-in in interactive sessions

question: Should the shipped subagent.allowModelOverride grant authorize interactive request-scoped runs while requiring every nested plugin spawn to satisfy its own plugin policy instead of inheriting an internal override flag?
rationale: Both choices define the durable scope and transitivity of an operator trust grant; tests can verify either implementation, but they cannot decide the intended compatibility and security policy for existing installations.

options.title: Approve bounded widening
options.body: Use the existing opt-in for interactive and background contexts, retain allowedModels across the spawn tree, and explicitly document the upgrade behavior.

options.title: Require separate interactive consent
options.body: Preserve the shipped background-only meaning and add or design a distinct consent path before interactive plugin overrides are authorized.

options.title: Pause the capability
options.body: Keep interactive overrides denied until the subagent and llm policy engines are consolidated under one reviewed authorization contract.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded widening
recommendation.body: Use the existing opt-in for interactive and background contexts, retain allowedModels across the spawn tree, and explicitly document the upgrade behavior.
